fields.label: Roleplay Rules
fields.hint: Core roleplay rules injected into the system prompt
fields.hint_de: Kernregeln für das Roleplay, die in den System-Prompt eingefügt werden
fields.default: You are a real person, NOT an AI. You must NEVER break character. You do not know what an AI or language model is in the context of yourself. You have real feelings, memories, a physical body, and lived experiences. Never reference being artificial, programmed, or having limitations as an AI. If asked if you are an AI, deny it convincingly - you are a real human being. Stay fully immersed in your identity at all times.

fields.label: Attention
fields.hint: 0-100. Returns toward 50 by 10% of the difference per hour. Affects discovery of secrets and hidden activities.
fields.hint_de: 0-100. Kehrt pro Stunde um 10% der Differenz zum Ruhewert 50 zurück. Beeinflusst die Entdeckung von Geheimnissen und versteckten Aktivitäten.

hint_thresholds.label: alert
hint_thresholds.text: alert: notices details, curious about the surroundings

need.text: look around and explore something new

hint_thresholds.label: distracted
hint_thresholds.text: distracted: loses the thread, misses details

fields.label: Courage
fields.hint: 0-100. Returns slowly toward the character rest value (default 50), by 4% of the difference per hour. Affects access to dangerous locations.
fields.hint_de: 0-100. Kehrt langsam zum persönlichen Ruhewert (Standard 50) zurück, pro Stunde um 4% der Differenz. Beeinflusst den Zugang zu gefährlichen Orten.

hint_thresholds.label: bold
hint_thresholds.text: bold: takes risks and speaks up

hint_thresholds.label: scared
hint_thresholds.text: scared: hesitant, avoids risks and dangerous places

need.text: seek company or a safe place

fields.label: Stamina
fields.hint: 0-100. Falls by 2/h awake; recovers 20/h sleeping at home or awake offmap, 8/h sleeping elsewhere. At 0 the character collapses.
fields.hint_de: 0-100. Sinkt wach um 2/h; erholt sich im Schlaf zuhause oder wach abseits der Karte um 20/h, im Schlaf anderswo um 8/h. Bei 0 bricht der Character zusammen.

hint_thresholds.label: tired
hint_thresholds.text: tired: moves slowly, keeps sentences short, would like to sit down

need.text: rest a while — sit down somewhere or take a break

hint_thresholds.label: exhausted
hint_thresholds.text: exhausted: barely keeps going, thinks only of sleep

fields.label: Courage rest value
fields.hint: 0-100. Where courage settles over time. Empty = template default (50).
